character.name: 饭团猫
character.anchors: a chubby white cat whose body is shaped like a rounded-triangle onigiri rice ball; a dark green nori seaweed band wraps around its belly; a small red pickled-plum (umeboshi) sits on top of its head between two small pointed ears; big round black eyes with white highlights; tiny pink nose; short stubby paws; no tail visible

both arms stretched wide open toward the viewer asking for a hug, pink blushing cheeks
holding a tiny steaming cup of milk in one paw, other paw waving, fresh morning smile
leaning sideways with the head tilted, one paw raised next to the face, curious round eyes
doubled over laughing, holding its belly, tears of joy at the eye corners, mouth wide open

one paw on the chin, eyes looking up and to the side, pondering

bowing deeply at the waist with both paws pressed together in thanks
running away to the right in a mid-stride pose, looking back over the shoulder, a sweat drop
eyes wide as plates, mouth open in an O, both paws on cheeks, fur standing on end
